mechanism: A Terafab ramp into advanced logic and memory requires production lithography systems, software, upgrades and field service that ASML can monetize; xLight's government-funded free-electron-laser work is a prototype source option rather than a qualified scanner replacement, while Terafab-specific tool orders and timing remain undisclosed.
catalyst: Terafab discloses a process node and binding ASML tool orders, accepts systems on site, begins wafer production, or creates recurring installed-base service and upgrade revenue with measurable economics.
invalidation: Terafab remains packaging or mature-node only; advanced-wafer phases are cancelled or delayed indefinitely; no ASML tools are ordered; export or permitting restrictions block delivery; project economics fail; or an alternative lithography route is qualified at competitive production scale.
